contentItems.label: Hero Sub-headline
contentItems.content: A CBSE Affiliated School in Jaipur — Nurturing Curious Minds, Building Future Leaders

contentItems.label: School Tagline
contentItems.note: Source document spells it 'Nuturing' — likely typo. Confirm correct spelling.

contentItems.label: About Section — Welcome Paragraph
contentItems.content: Welcome to Tilak Global School, where every child's potential is nurtured with care, creativity, and commitment. Situated in the heart of Jaipur, our school is a CBSE-affiliated institution dedicated to providing quality education from Play Group to Class XII.

contentItems.label: About Section — Extended Description
contentItems.content: At Tilak Global School, we believe education is not just about academics — it's about building well-rounded individuals. Our experienced faculty, modern infrastructure, and holistic approach ensure that every student thrives — academically, socially, and emotionally.

contentItems.label: School Founded Year
contentItems.note: Not mentioned in any source document. Confirm with client.

contentItems.label: Total Students Count
contentItems.note: Left blank in source document. Confirm current enrolment figure.

contentItems.label: Vision Statement
contentItems.content: To be a centre of excellence that empowers students with knowledge, values, and skills to become responsible global citizens.

contentItems.label: Mission Statement
contentItems.content: To provide a holistic, student-centred education that integrates academic excellence with character development, creativity, and life skills through experienced faculty, modern infrastructure, and a nurturing environment.

contentItems.label: Principal Name
contentItems.note: Principal name not provided in any document. Confirm full name and designation.

contentItems.label: Principal Message
contentItems.content: Dear Students, Parents, and Well-Wishers, It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to Tilak Global School — a place where dreams take shape and futures are built. Education at Tilak Global is not confined to textbooks; it is a journey of discovery, growth, and transformation.

contentItems.label: Chairman Name
contentItems.note: Name not stated in documents. Visible in chairman_and_director photo — older man in black sherwani. Confirm full name.

contentItems.label: Director Name
contentItems.note: Document says Abhay Tanwar. Old static site data says R.S. Tanwar. Confirm correct name.

contentItems.label: Director Message
contentItems.content: At Tilak Global School, we are committed to creating an environment where every child is inspired to learn, explore, and excel. Our dedicated team of educators works tirelessly to ensure that every student receives personalised attention and guidance.

contentItems.label: Academic Streams Offered
contentItems.note: About section lists Science, Commerce, Humanities. FAQ section lists Arts and Commerce only. Confirm all streams for Class XI-XII.

content.question: What is the affiliation board of Tilak Global School?
content.answer: Tilak Global School is affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), New Delhi. Affiliation No: 1730870.

content.question: What classes are offered at Tilak Global School?
content.answer: We offer classes from Play Group (Pre-Nursery) to Class XII.

content.question: What streams are available in Class XI and XII?
content.answer: CONFLICT — see CF-02. Document A: Science, Commerce, Humanities. Document B (FAQ): Arts and Commerce. Confirm with client.

content.question: Is transport facility available?
content.answer: Yes, school bus service is available. Fee is charged based on distance. See CF-05 for per-km rate conflict.

content.question: What is the admission process?
content.answer: Fill the application form, submit required documents, appear for interaction/assessment (Class I+), pay fees, and collect the admission kit.

content.question: What documents are required for admission?
content.answer: Birth certificate, TC (if applicable), previous marksheet, Aadhaar (child and parent), 4 photographs, residence proof, caste certificate if applicable.

content.question: Does the school have a hostel facility?
content.note: Not mentioned in any document. Confirm and add answer. See CF-12.

content.question: What are the school timings?
content.note: Office timings are 8 AM–2 PM but school session timings not stated. See CF-13.

cloudinaryStatus.riskDescription: Files uploaded to Render's ephemeral disk are lost on every deploy, dyno restart, or crash. All gallery images and documents uploaded via CMS will disappear without warning.
cloudinaryStatus.recommendation: Integrate Cloudinary (or AWS S3) before bulk-uploading any client content. Replace multer.diskStorage() with multer-storage-cloudinary. Update all upload routes. Store Cloudinary URLs in MongoDB instead of local paths.
cloudinaryStatus.note: No cloudinary dependency found in backend/package.json. No CLOUDINARY_* env vars set. This is a blocking issue before production content upload.
